headline: Strides Pharma submits SEBI dematerialisation compliance certificate
hook: Routine regulatory filing for Strides Pharma
summary: Strides Pharma Science has filed its mandatory compliance certificate with SEBI regarding share dematerialisation. This filing confirms the company's adherence to regulatory standards for electronic shareholding. Such certificates are a standard procedural requirement for listed entities in India. The filing ensures the company remains in compliance with depository regulations.
why_it_matters: Standard regulatory compliance with no immediate impact on share price.
